resources.string: Edit the database connection and verify it before saving.
A verified database connection is required to continue. The configuration is saved only after a successful connection check.
Edit your database configuration. Changes are saved only after a successful connection check; going back leaves the saved configuration unchanged.
Paste a URL, JDBC URL, or configuration
Manual changes are parsed automatically. Invalid text is kept for correction. A valid import fills the fields below and clears this box.
Encrypts the connection and verifies the certificate and host. Use a trusted server certificate and its matching hostname.
Warning: the connection is encrypted, but the certificate and hostname are not verified. A malicious server could impersonate your database.
Warning: no TLS. Credentials and database traffic can be intercepted. Only use on a trusted, isolated network.
Connection cancelled. No configuration was saved. Edit the fields or retry.
Invalid configuration. Check the host, port (1–65535), database, username and TLS mode, or correct the pasted text.
Unable to connect. Check the host, port, network and database server availability.
The connection check timed out. Check the network and server, then retry.
Authentication failed. Check the username, password and server access rules.
The database is unavailable or access is denied. Check its name and permissions.
TLS verification failed. Check the server certificate and hostname. Disabling verification reduces security.
The connection was verified, but saving failed. Access has not been granted. Retry to check and save again.
Unable to load the saved configuration. Retry loading, or enter a new configuration and verify it before replacing the saved one.
The connection check failed unexpectedly. Review the configuration and retry.
The shared database schema is incompatible. Check the loemby tables; the app will not modify their structure.
The database configuration changed. Refresh and retry in the selected database.
The shared record no longer exists. Refresh the list.
The write result is unknown. Refresh to confirm the saved state before retrying.
